色胆加上酒胆，让他不再犹豫，直接扑上她身，便要扯下她胸前的被褥。

绦岚秋吓得不顾一切，拿起簪子便是一阵猛挥，「不要！走开！快走开——」

「该死！」男人手上马上浮现一道道血痕，痛得他大声咒骂，酒也醒了几分。「搞什么！你这贱女人，居然敢伤本大爷！」

成功吓阻他，她总算安心了些，厉声说：「不许再靠近我！出去！给我出去！」

「他妈的！」他低骂，当真转身走出房门。

见他离开，绦岚秋总算松了口气，才想下床将房门锁上，谁知男人去而复返，这一回还带了个女人来。

「是……是你？」绦岚秋脸色一白，即便头脑昏沉，可聪明的她马上猜到这是怎么一回事。

「凝姬姑娘，是你说这女人任我摆布，现在这笔帐该怎么算？」男人恼怒的问着。

「放心……」凝姬勾起一抹媚笑，安抚道：「她吃了万花楼最新的**药，那药会让人飘飘欲仙，完全不晓得自己在做什么，药效差不多就要发挥，到时别说是任你摆布，巴着你不放都有可能。」

闻言，男人这才稍减不悦，「这可是你说的，到时要是成不了事，你可得陪我一夜，老实说，凝姬姑娘还是比较合我的意。」

花魁谁不想尝，尤其是像凝姬这种光是瞧就让人酥麻入骨的美人儿，床上的女人虽然也美，可他还想要命，谁知她下一次划伤的会是哪里。

「就怕到时爷会玩得乐不思蜀，连凝姬是谁都给忘了……」凝姬娇笑，眼中却闪过一抹嫌恶。

绦岚秋压根没细听他们的对话，只听见三个字。

**药？她身子一震，手上的簪子差点滑落。

怪不得她不仅浑身无力，身子更是像有千万只蚂蚁在攀爬，麻痒得难受，直想要人替她……

她紧咬着下唇，力道之大，甚至让粉嫩的唇渗出点点鲜血，好不容易才拉回一些理智，「你……你究竟想干么？」

凝姬斜睨她一眼，勾起笑，附在她耳边说：「没想做什么，只是想让你尝尝在青楼里送往迎来的滋味，你可要争气点，除了这位柳公子，后头还有三、四位爷排队等着，过了今夜，我便将你卖至外地的青楼妓院，让那口口声声说一生只爱你一人的男人永远找不到你！」

她说得轻松，可听在绦岚秋耳中却犹如青天霹雳，震得她浑身发抖。

「你怎么能……掳人是犯法的，更何况就算是这样，竞天哥也不会爱你……」

「闭嘴！」凝姬怒瞪着她绋红的双颊，扬起笑又说：「会或不会可不是由你决定，到时你我一样是残花败柳，看他会要谁……哦！应该说，他就算想要你，也得先找到你再说，只不过，那时你已不知让多少男人给睡过了。」

她的话宛如一桶冰水，绦岚秋却感到身子益发灼热，让她忍不住想自行拉开紧裹在身上的被褥。

见状，凝姬笑得更加开怀，毫不费力的拿起她握在手中的簪子，扬声说：「柳爷，时候差不多了，你可得快些，别忘了，后头还有人等着呢！」

男人闻言，急色的搓着双手，便往绦岚秋扑去，「小美人，让爷好好疼你……」

「不要……」绦岚秋哑声低喊，益发昏沉迷离的神智让她无力抵抗，只能任由男人在她身上狎玩，几近绝望的闭上双眼……

再次醒来，天色已亮，绦岚秋傻傻的看着顶上的红帐帘，身下传来的阵阵酸麻让她知道自己并没有逃过一劫。

泪水缓缓滑下脸颊，她终究还是配不上封竞天，无法与他长相厮守……

现在的她根本不在意自己能否得救，或是真会被卖至其他青楼，她在意的是，她这已不纯洁的身子，就算封竞天仍要她，她也无法接受，想着昨夜不知有多少男人在她身上狎玩、凌辱，她脸一白，感到一阵恶心。

这样的她，活在世上有何意义？

像木偶似的坐起身，她双眼无神的拾起地上的衣物，一件一件的套上，只留下腰带。

空洞的望着上方的梁柱，泪水又滑落。

她好不甘心……真的好不甘心，好不容易才能和心爱的男人在一起，好不容易能成为他的妻，没想到却……

悲痛的闭上双眼，她在心中嘶喊、大哭，却怎么也发不出声，只能任由泪水静

默的爬满她精致却苍白如雪的娇颜。

颤着手，她搬来矮凳，缓缓的站上，将手中腰带抛上梁柱，打上死结。

今生……她无缘成为他的妻，只求来生与他再续前缘……

闭上双眼，她抬起下颚，将腰带悬住自己的脖子，深吸口气，便要将脚下矮凳给踢开。

「岚秋？」

突如其来的惊喊让绦岚秋睁开双眼，当她看见眼前之人竟是封竞天时，心儿一颤，她牙一咬，狠心的踹开矮凳。

封竞天简直不敢置信，她竟敢当着他的面自尽，他急忙拿起桌上茶碗，奋力一摔，将碎片飞扔而去。

腰带一断，她纤细的身子也随之跌落在地，不住的猛咳，「咳！咳咳咳——」

「你这是在做什么！」封竞天怒不可遏的大喊，一想到他若是晚来一步……他紧紧的将她抱入怀中，那后果他连想都不敢想。

依偎在他怀中，绦岚秋不停的哭着，想将他推开，「别碰我，我……很脏……」

连她都无法忍受自己的肮脏，更何况是他？

「你在胡说什么？」他拧眉，不解的问。

「我……昨夜……我被……被……」她实在不愿回想昨夜的一切，咬着唇，无法再说下去。

想到昨夜，封竞天眼中闪过一抹杀气，却柔声安慰，「没事了，我已经将一切处理好了，别怕，一切有我。」

但绦岚秋仍是不住的颤抖，「不……你不懂，我很脏，真的很脏，他们……他们……」

她说不出口自己惨遭奸污，说不出口自己已不是只属于他的绦岚秋……

「他们全都该死！」封竞天眼一沉，接着又说：「若不是昨晚官府的人也在场，他们全都已经死了，绝不会只是被关入牢里那么简单。那些人，尤其是凝姬，我绝不会就这么算了，这帐，我会一笔一笔的讨回来。」

绦岚秋一震，听见了关键字眼。「你……你是说你昨晚就找到我了？」

可能吗？但是她的身体……

「当然！」封竞天有些不解的看着她，反问：「你忘了吗？那该死的杂碎胆敢对你上下其手，若不是被衙役阻止，我早已一刀把他砍死！」

「我……」她有些迷惑的看着他，摇头，「我记不得了……」

她只记得她绝望的放弃了挣扎，加上脑袋愈来愈昏沉，她根本记不得任何事，倒是有听见一阵吵杂的声响……

「昨夜究竟发生什么事？我只记得我被下了春药……那么我到底有没有……有没有……」支吾了好半天，她仍旧问不出口。

见她惨白着俏睑，封竞天总算明白她为何一直说自己脏，他再次在心里将凝姬和那个杂碎给干刀万刮，紧紧拥着她，他柔声说：「你放心，你没有让任何人糟蹋。」

「但是我……」不是她不信他，而是下身的酸麻让她质疑。

知道她的疑惑，封竞天勾起笑，在她耳边说：「你真的不记得了？你吃了春药，唯一能救你的，当然只有我。」

这话让绦岚秋一怔，傻傻的看着他。难不成……

「你是说……昨夜抱我的人……是你？」这是真的吗，还是这只是他编出来安慰她的谎言？

The combination of lust and alcohol made him hesitate no longer, and pounced on her directly, trying to pull off the quilt from her chest.

Wei Lanqiu was so frightened that she didn't care about anything. She picked up the hairpin and waved it violently, "No! Go away! Go away quickly——"

"Damn it!" Blood marks immediately appeared on the man's hands. The pain caused him to curse loudly, and he woke up a little from the wine."What are you doing! You bitch, how dare you hurt me!"

After successfully frightening him, she finally felt relieved and said sternly: "Don't come near me again! Get out! Get out!"

"Fuck!" He cursed, then turned around and walked out of the room.

Seeing him leaving, Guan Lanqiu finally breathed a sigh of relief, and then she wanted to get out of bed and lock the door. Unexpectedly, the man came back again, and this time he brought a woman with him.

"It's...is it you?" Qian Lanqiu's face turned pale. Even though her mind was groggy, she was smart enough to guess what was going on.

"Miss Ningji, you said that this woman is at my mercy. How should I settle the debt now?" the man asked angrily.

"Don't worry..." Ning Ji gave her a charming smile and comforted her, "She took Wanhualou's latest drug. The drug will make people feel ecstasy and have no idea what they are doing. The effect of the drug is about to take effect. Don't say that she will be at your mercy by then. It is possible that she won't let you go."

Hearing this, the man became less unhappy and said, "This is what you said. If it doesn't work out then, you have to stay with me for the night. To be honest, Miss Ning Ji is more to my liking."

Who doesn't want to taste an oiran, especially a beauty like Ning Ji who makes people tingle just by looking at her? Although the woman on the bed is also beautiful, he still wants to die. Who knows where she will scratch her next time.

"I'm afraid that by then I'll be having so much fun that I forget who Ning Ji is..." Ning Ji smiled sweetly, but a hint of disgust flashed in her eyes.

Qi Lanqiu didn't listen at all to their conversation and only heard three words.

**medicine?She was shaken and the hairpin in her hand almost slipped off.

No wonder she was not only weak, but also felt like there were millions of ants crawling around her body. She was so itchy that she wanted someone to take her place...

She bit her lower lip tightly, so hard that a little blood oozed from her pink lips. She finally managed to regain some sense, "You...what do you want to do?"

Ning Ji glanced sideways at her, smiled, and whispered in her ear: "I didn't want to do anything, I just want you to taste the feeling of being welcomed into a brothel. You have to be more confident. In addition to Mr. Liu, there are three or four men waiting in line. After tonight, I will sell you to a brothel in another place, so that the man who keeps saying that he only loves you in his life will never find you!"

She said it easily, but when she heard it, it was like a thunderbolt from the blue sky, making her tremble all over.

"How could you... kidnapping is illegal, not to mention that even if it is the case, Brother Jingtian will not love you..."

"Shut up!" Ning Ji glared at her crimson cheeks, raised a smile and said, "It's not up to you to decide whether you will. By then, you and I will be in ruins. It depends on who he will want... Oh! It should be said that even if he wants you, he has to find you first. However, you have already slept with many men by then."

Her words were like a bucket of ice water, but Gui Lanqiu felt her body getting hotter and hotter, making her unable to help but want to pull away the quilt that was tightly wrapped around her.

Seeing this, Ning Ji smiled even more heartily, effortlessly picked up the hairpin in her hand, and said loudly: "Master Liu, it's almost time, you have to hurry up, don't forget, there are people waiting behind you!"

Hearing this, the man rubbed his hands anxiously and rushed towards Gui Lanqiu, "Little beauty, please let me love you well..."

"No..." Guan Lanqiu shouted hoarsely. Her increasingly dazed mind made her unable to resist. She could only let the man play with her, closing her eyes almost in despair...

When she woke up again, it was already dawn. Guan Lanqiu looked stupidly at the red curtain on the top. The tingling pain coming from her body made her know that she had not escaped.

Tears slowly slid down her cheeks. After all, she was still not worthy of Feng Jingtian and could not stay with him forever...

Now she didn't care at all whether she could be saved or whether she would be sold to another brothel. What she cared about was that her body was no longer pure. Even if Feng Jingtian still wanted her, she couldn't accept it. Thinking about how many men played with and humiliated her last night, her face turned pale and she felt sick.

What's the point of living in this world for her like this?

Sitting up like a puppet, she picked up the clothes on the floor with dull eyes and put them on one by one, leaving only her belt.

Looking blankly at the beams above, tears fell again.

She was so unwilling... she was really unwilling. It was not easy for her to be with the man she loved, and it was so hard for her to become his wife, but she didn't expect...

Closing her eyes in grief, she screamed and cried in her heart, but she couldn't make a sound and could only let her tears fall silent.

Silence covered her delicate but pale face as snow.

With trembling hands, she moved a low stool, stood up slowly, threw the belt in her hand onto the beam, and tied it in a tight knot.

In this life...she has no chance of becoming his wife, and she only hopes to renew her relationship with him in the next life...

She closed her eyes, raised her chin, hung the belt around her neck, took a deep breath, and kicked the low stool away from her feet.

"Lan Qiu?"

The sudden scream made Guan Lanqiu open her eyes. When she saw that the person in front of her was Feng Jingtian, her heart trembled. She gritted her teeth and kicked the low stool away cruelly.

Feng Jingtian couldn't believe that she dared to commit suicide in front of him. He hurriedly picked up the tea bowl on the table, slammed it hard, and threw the pieces away.

As soon as the belt was broken, her slender body fell to the ground. She kept coughing violently, "Cough! Cough cough cough -"

"What are you doing!" Feng Jingtian shouted angrily. When he thought about it if he was a step too late... He hugged her tightly into his arms, and he didn't even dare to think about the consequences.

Nestling in his arms, Qian Lanqiu kept crying and wanted to push him away, "Don't touch me, I'm... very dirty..."

Even she couldn't bear her own filth, let alone him?

"What are you talking about?" He frowned and asked in confusion.

"I...last night...I was...by..." She really didn't want to think about everything last night, biting her lip, unable to say any more.

Thinking of last night, a murderous look flashed in Feng Jingtian's eyes, but he comforted him softly, "It's okay. I have taken care of everything. Don't be afraid. I have everything under control."

But Qi Lanqiu could not help but tremble, "No... you don't understand, I am very dirty, really dirty, they... they..."

She couldn't tell that she had been raped, she couldn't tell that she was no longer just his Qi Lanqiu...

"They all deserve to die!" Feng Jingtian's eyes darkened, and then he added: "If it weren't for the presence of the government officials last night, they would all be dead, and they would not be just thrown into prison. Those people, especially Ning Ji, I will never let it go like this. I will get this debt back one by one."

Guan Lanqiu was shocked and heard the key words."You...you mean you found me last night?"

Is it possible?But her body...

"Of course!" Feng Jingtian looked at her with some confusion and asked, "Have you forgotten? That damn bastard dared to lay hands on you. If the officer hadn't stopped him, I would have chopped him to death!"

"I..." She looked at him in confusion and shook her head, "I can't remember..."

She only remembered that she gave up struggling in despair, and her head was getting more and more dizzy. She couldn't remember anything at all, but she did hear a loud noise...

"What exactly happened last night? I only remember that I was given an aphrodisiac... So did I... did I..." After hesitating for a long time, she still couldn't ask.

Seeing her pale and pretty face, Feng Jingtian finally understood why she kept saying that she was dirty. He once again blamed Ning Ji and that bastard in his heart. He hugged her tightly and said softly, "Don't worry, you didn't let anyone mess with you."

"But I..." It wasn't that she didn't believe him, but the soreness and numbness in her lower body made her question it.

Knowing her doubts, Feng Jingtian smiled and said in her ear: "You really don't remember? You took the aphrodisiac, and of course the only one who can save you is me."

These words made Qi Lanqiu startled and looked at him stupidly.Is it possible...

"You mean... the person who hugged me last night... was you?" Is this true, or is this just a lie he made up to comfort her?
